name: Mine Card
summary: Mine is a pre-launch Swiss neobank on stablecoin rails: a CHF and EUR IBAN in your own name that settles as USDC in a self-custodial wallet, plus a Mastercard accepted in 175+ countries. Non-custodial by default, with opt-in 5% yield via Aave V3 and free instant Mine-to-Mine transfers. Sign-up is not live yet.

fees.topup: 0% card top-up; on-ramp US$0.90 flat at 1:1, first 500 CHF/EUR conversion free

rewards.cashback: None on Basic; 0.5% USDC on Premium (max US$25/month)
rewards.referralBonus: Invite codes give card discounts (free Basic / 20% off Premium); invite rewards in development

availabilityNotes: Mine is pre-launch — sign-up is currently listed as 'coming soon', so this page describes announced specifications that may change. The Mastercard is accepted in 172–175 countries including the US, but the account, IBAN and conversion services are not available to US persons or Russian citizens, or to residents of a small restricted list. Onboarding follows AML rules and some countries require extra verification.

kyc.notes: Onboarding follows AML rules and requires identity verification, with extra checks in some countries. The account and IBAN are not available to US persons or Russian citizens regardless of residence.

faq.question: Is the Mine card available now?
faq.answer: No. Mine is pre-launch and sign-up is currently listed as 'coming soon'. This page describes announced specifications, which may change before launch.

faq.question: Where is Mine available?
faq.answer: The Mastercard is accepted in 172–175 countries including the US. The account, IBAN and conversion services are not available to US persons or Russian citizens, or to residents of a small restricted list.

faq.question: What fees does the Mine card charge?
faq.answer: The Basic virtual card is US$5 one-off (free with an invite code) and Premium is US$124 (US$99 with a code), with no subscription on those tiers. Card top-up is 0%, FX is up to 1.5% on Basic (about 0.25% on Premium), and international ATM withdrawals cost US$5.

faq.question: Is my money safe with Mine?
faq.answer: Mine is non-custodial: your balance is USDC in a wallet you control, so Mine cannot freeze or seize it and funds remain accessible if Mine shuts down. There is no government deposit insurance, and the optional 5% Earn routes funds into Aave V3 smart contracts, which carry smart-contract risk.

faq.question: Do I need crypto experience to use Mine?
faq.answer: No. Your CHF or EUR IBAN works like a normal bank account and incoming money settles as USDC automatically. Crypto and tokenized stocks are optional features you opt into rather than requirements.
